preamble: Each clue prefaced by a number in square brackets provides a cryptic indication of a word from a well-known poem (not further defined), minus a single letter. Its solution should be entered without this letter. These missing letters in numbered order give the name of the author, which should be entered in the solution form where indicated.

clue.text: Diminished ace was at the crease, half-heartedly

explanation.walkthrough: The crease is the line a cricket batsman stands at, so being at the crease means batting.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that has abated has lessened or died down, a close synonym of diminished.
